scope: one local mock-backend run after backend status fix
method: Natural-language task in installed Pi Desktop. Pi called browser tools; Codex confirmed local actions and manually opened the page file input and selected the generated local CSV.
issues: Upstream model returned 429 overloaded before recovering.
After the agent clicked the file input, the native file picker was not visible and the in-app work panel was closed; Codex expanded the panel and manually clicked the file input to open the picker.
The model claimed the file picker had opened automatically, which was inconsistent with the observed UI.
A read operation failed because no fresh observation was available; the model observed again and recovered.
limitations: One local run, no success-rate or comparative speed claim.
Multiple approvals, panel expansion and file selection performed by Codex.
No production platform or anti-bot evaluation.
Displayed cost and token usage are UI estimates, not independently verified billing.
